title: Site Mission Control
subtitle: Plan, fly, adapt
introTitle: A short site mission. A real decision.
introText: Survey the external roof edge from the designated launch area. A marked crane work area is excluded. Plan the route, fly toward the inspection point, then respond if site conditions change.
goal: Goal: plan a suitable operation and return safely when the site changes.
launchUnreviewed: Use an unreviewed space near the works
responseHold: Hold, reassess, and return if the route becomes unsuitable
planIncomplete: Make all three planning decisions before launch.
planUnsafe: This plan needs revision. Keep clear of the known work area, use the designated pad, and prepare to reassess a changed route.
planGood: Plan cleared. The drone will hold position whenever you release the controls.
flightText: W/S or ↑/↓ move along the corridor; A/D or ←/→ move sideways; Q/E descend/ascend. Release keys to hover. Keep out of the marked crane area.
checkpoint: Inspection point reached. The remaining corridor has changed.
adaptText: Crane activity now closes the corridor ahead. The drone is holding position. Choose a professional response before moving.
adaptReturn: Hold, reassess, and return to the designated pad
adaptWrong: The original route now crosses an active exclusion area. Reassess and choose a safe resolution.
adaptGood: Correct decision. Fly back to the marked pad and land.
returnText: Fly to the launch pad. Descend with Q and select Land when inside the pad marker.
notAtPad: Move inside the designated pad marker and descend before landing.
zone: Excluded work area entered. The drone has been moved to the last safe point; revise your route.
newZone: The new exclusion area is active. Return along the safe corridor.
resultPass: Safe interruption completed. Your planning, site compliance, and response supported a responsible outcome.
resultFail: The safe outcome was completed, but the score is below the pass threshold. Replay to improve the professional decisions.
resultUnfinished: This attempt ended before a safe return and landing. Replay to complete the professional response.
